tests.name: validator_self_test
tests.description: Run validators/rustre-deobf-vm.py __main__ self-test as sanity check on the Python reimplementation (no MCP comparison).
tests.validator_result: self-tests pass: PushImm 5 + PushImm 7 + Add -> 12; VmDispatcherDetector finds SIG1 entry=0xDEADBEEF count=16; VmDetector flags VMProtect + dispatcher_count>=1

summary: rustre-deobf-vm has no MCP tool exposure in rustre-mcp (wire_tools.rs registers deobf_mba_normalize but no vm_detect/vm_dispatcher_scan/vm_lift_bytecode). The Python validator reimplements the crate's VM detection, dispatcher detection, lifter, simulator, and clustering, and its self-tests pass. There is no JSON-RPC stdio surface to compare against, so structural mismatch is recorded. To enable future comparison, expose VmDetector/VmDispatcherDetector/VmLifter through rustre-mcp as vm_detect / vm_dispatcher_scan / vm_lift_bytecode tools.
